name: self-compact
description: Lets Claude compact its own context (a real /compact: the chat history stays visible), carry text verbatim across it and resume itself

alwaysInstructions.title: Always keep (summary instructions)
alwaysInstructions.description: Added to the summarizer's instructions on every compaction of the main conversation, typed /compact and auto-compaction included.

alwaysCarry.title: Always carry (verbatim after the summary)
alwaysCarry.description: Placed verbatim after the summary on every compaction of the main conversation, e.g. 'Re-read docs/HANDOFF.md before continuing.'

minIntervalMinutes.title: Minimum minutes between self-compactions
minIntervalMinutes.description: The request_compaction tool refuses a new request within this many minutes of the last self-compaction in the same session. /self-compact interval <min> overrides it for one session.

maxCompactions.title: Maximum self-compactions per session
maxCompactions.description: The request_compaction tool refuses once a session has self-compacted this many times; 0 means no limit. /self-compact max <n> overrides it for one session.

maxResumes.title: Maximum resumes in a row
maxResumes.description: How many self-compactions in a row may start the next turn with `resume` before a prompt from you; past it the resume is withheld and the session waits for you. 0 turns resume off. /self-compact resumes <n> overrides it for one session.
